Fast, Reliable Roof Repairs You Can Trust

A leaking roof is more than just a nuisance; it’s an immediate threat to your home's interior, insulation, and structural integrity. Whether caused by missing shingles from high winds, hail impact, or aging flashing, water will always find the path of least resistance.

At Core Four Roofing, our expert technicians specialize in pinpoint leak detection. We don't just patch the visible symptom; we find the true source of the intrusion. From replacing damaged shingles and resealing pipe jacks to fixing failing valley flashing, we deliver permanent repairs that restore your roof's watertight defense.

item.html: Frequently Asked Questions About Roof Repairs
item.text: Frequently Asked Questions About Roof Repairs

items.q: How do I know if my roof has a leak?
items.a: Look for water stains on your ceiling or walls, peeling paint, damp insulation in your attic, or missing and cracked shingles on the roof's exterior.

items.q: Can I repair a roof leak myself?
items.a: We highly advise against it. Walking on a damaged roof is dangerous, and improper DIY patching with caulk or tar often traps moisture, making the underlying rot worse.

items.q: How much does a roof repair cost?
items.a: The cost depends entirely on the extent of the damage, the materials needed, and the steepness of the roof. We provide free, upfront estimates so you know exactly what to expect before we begin.

items.q: Will a repair fix a sagging roof deck?
items.a: If your roof deck is visibly sagging, it usually indicates severe structural rot. In this case, a simple surface repair won't work, and those sections of decking will need to be replaced.
